palette: 42 material-ramp colors derived from the approved concept; see author_bed.gd HEX
authoring: PixelPen native indexed layers; trace repaint, cluster cleanup, embroidery and fold finishing; save, reopen, export
deployment: Reusable asset only, no live room placement or web deployment
tileMapNotes: One scene tile places the entire furniture. Reserve 2x3 world tiles (4x6 half-unit editor cells). TileSet floor depth is rounded to 45 screen pixels; exact projection remains in the scene. Do not rotate the 2D sprite to create new viewing directions.
collisionNotes: Standalone physics shapes included. Arcana room navigation uses separate layout rectangles: register the same footprint in the room when placing.
